payload.claim: No test verifies that `reviewed_diff` and `diff` are mapped to the correct headings in the verdict prompt — every assertion added by this change (`tests/test_rebut.py::test_the_verdict_prompt_carries_the_diff_its_blockers_were_filed_against` and `tests/test_session.py::test_the_verdict_prompt_carries_the_diff_the_lenses_were_shown`) only checks that both diff strings and both heading strings appear somewhere in the prompt, never that a given diff sits under its correct heading. Swapping the two kwargs here — `diff=reviewed_diff, reviewed_diff=diff` — would put the pre-rebuttal (findings-filed-against) diff under "The diff, after the rebuttal" and the post-rebuttal diff under "The diff your findings were filed against", exactly recreating the bug this spec exists to fix (a critic reading a blocker's line number against the wrong tree), yet every gate and every new test stays green because they only test substring containment, not positional/heading association.
